pages.title: Meiolania
pages.text: $(o)Meiolania$() ($(o)Meiolania platyceps$()) was a giant horned turtle that lived on Lord Howe Island, east of Australia, during the Late Pleistocene.$(br2)Its shell was about a metre long, its head carried large cow-like horns and could not be pulled into the shell, and its tail was sheathed in spiked rings ending in a bony club.$(br2)It was not a true tortoise. It vanished before people reached the island, but a relative on Vanuatu survived until about 3,000 years ago.
